title: task list --status Paused is refused as "Task status is not configured", though task pause sets it
description: Found 2026-09-27 while checking what was left open after pausing QCLI-368. `quest task status-flow` reports statuses ["To Do","In Progress","Done"] with pausedStatus "Paused", and `quest task pause` sets a task to Paused. But `quest task list --status Paused` exits 6 with {"error_type":"validation","message":"Task status is not configured."}, on installed 0.10.0 and on the v0.11.0 build (eb1d9f4) alike, while an unfiltered `task list` shows three Paused tasks (QCLI-307, QCLI-327, QCLI-368). So a status the tool itself assigns cannot be used as a list filter, and a caller wanting "what is parked" has to list everything and filter client-side. The status filter apparently validates against `statuses` only and ignores `pausedStatus`.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest task list --status <the configured paused status> lists exactly the paused tasks, exit 0
A status that is neither in statuses nor the paused status is still refused with exit 6
A test covers both, and a mutation control shows the first fails on the current code

finalSummary:
The list filters (task list --status and --exclude-status) now resolve through TaskService.resolveFilterStatus. It accepts the configured pausedStatus, casefolded, and otherwise defers to resolveStatus. Writes still use resolveStatus, which refuses the paused status, so task pause remains the only way into it (QCLI-229).

VERIFIED:
- AC1: test/qcli392-list-paused-status.test.ts pauses T-1 in a fresh workspace. `task list --status Paused` and `--status paused` each exit 0 with empty stderr and list exactly [T-1]. `--exclude-status Paused` lists [T-2, T-3].
- AC2: `--status Parked` and `--exclude-status Parked` still exit 6 with a validation error. `task edit --status Paused` still exits 6 and leaves the task In Progress.
- AC3: against the pre-fix code, the AC1 test FAILED (Expected exit 0, got the refusal), and the two guard tests passed. After the fix, all 3 pass.
- bun run check: 881 pass, 0 fail, exit 0.

FOUND IN PASSING: test/integration/tasks/cli-semantics.test.ts pinned the bug. It used "Paused" as its example of an unconfigured status. Its history (889cfbc, QCLI-287) shows the example was "Blocked" until the default pausedStatus was renamed, and the rename mechanically made it the configured paused status. The example is now "Parked", with a comment explaining why.
